request.system: You are a fraud analytics feature engineer. Task: rank Medicare providers for audit. Each of 5,410 providers carries a PotentialFraud label (9.35% flagged) whose origin is undocumented; treat it as suspicion, not confirmed fraud. Claims run 27 Nov 2008 to 31 Dec 2009. The primary metric is PR-AUC; the audit queue holds about 100 providers. Existing provider features are grouped into families below. Propose new provider-level features that describe HOW a provider bills rather than HOW MUCH, because claim volume already explains most of the label. Use only the claim columns and provider bases the schema allows. Never use the label. (Independent run 3.)

claim_aggregates.name: agent_ip_reimb_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Dispersion of inpatient payments shows templated or uniform billing versus natural case-mix variation.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_reimb_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Outpatient payment spread captures unusual uniformity or erratic amounts independent of volume.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_ndiag_mean
claim_aggregates.rationale: Outpatient diagnosis code count per claim indicates possible code stuffing in outpatient billing.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_ip_ndiag_max
claim_aggregates.rationale: Extreme diagnosis counts on inpatient claims flag upcoding outliers.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_nproc_mean
claim_aggregates.rationale: Procedure count per outpatient claim reflects unbundling or procedure-heavy billing.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_ip_los_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Variation in length of stay reveals formulaic stays versus natural variability.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_all_claimdays_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Spread in claim duration indicates uniform or manipulated claim periods.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_all_dupany_pos
claim_aggregates.rationale: Share of claims duplicated anywhere targets repeated billing patterns beyond volume.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_dupsame_pos
claim_aggregates.rationale: Same-provider outpatient duplicates suggest resubmission of identical claims.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_chronic_mean
claim_aggregates.rationale: Patient chronic burden among outpatients tests whether billing matches patient complexity.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_op_deduct_pos
claim_aggregates.rationale: Share of outpatient claims with a deductible captures unusual cost-sharing patterns.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_all_attop_pos
claim_aggregates.rationale: Attending physician doubling as operating physician indicates concentrated physician roles.

ratios.name: agent_claims_per_attending
ratios.rationale: Claims concentrated on few attending physicians suggests a physician-centric billing pattern.

ratios.name: agent_ip_reimb_per_ipclaim
ratios.rationale: Average inpatient payment per claim, a billing intensity measure normalized by volume.

ratios.name: agent_op_reimb_per_opclaim
ratios.rationale: Average outpatient payment per claim normalized by volume.

ratios.name: agent_bene_per_claim
ratios.rationale: Beneficiary breadth per claim indicates repeated billing on the same patients.

ratios.name: agent_dgc_per_ipclaim
ratios.rationale: Diversity of diagnosis groups relative to inpatient volume signals narrow or broad case selection.

ratios.name: agent_admitdiag_per_ipclaim
ratios.rationale: Admit diagnosis variety per inpatient claim indicates templated admissions.

ratios.name: agent_states_per_bene
ratios.rationale: Geographic spread of patients relative to patient count may indicate unusual patient sourcing.

ratios.name: agent_operating_per_attending
ratios.rationale: Operating-to-attending physician ratio reflects physician staffing structure in billing.
